story_type: disguised spy jet takeoff, historic film
hook: This NASA jet took off under a fake serial number.
narration: This NASA jet took off under a fake serial number.
NASA labeled this 1970s takeoff a YF-12C.
It was really an SR-71 Blackbird, the second one ever built, hidden behind a false number.
outcome: Then the disguised Blackbird climbed away over the Mojave.
title: The Blackbird with a fake number
description:
A 1970s NASA film of a so-called YF-12C taking off from Edwards Air Force Base in California's Mojave Desert. The jet was really SR-71 airframe 61-7951, loaned to NASA under the false number 60-6937 to hide its identity.

Footage: NASA Armstrong Flight Research Center video, via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:YF-12C_Takeoff_from_Edwards_Air_Force_Base.webm
